guide_solution: Add suffixes/prefixes to the root words: There are (a) various forms of physical exercise. But every form is not (b) suitable for all. Walking is good for all. In the morning, fresh air is (c) available. So it is (d) beneficial to health. It is also very (e) pleasing and (f) enjoyable. It also (g) freshens our mind. The (h) natural beauty (i) bewitches us. We become (j) healthy and wealthy.
